name: IDropTarget
reason: SHGetDesktopFolder (aa453697, "Windows CE .NET 4.2 and later", Shlobj.h) takes IShellFolder**; the opaque tag must be nameable at 4.2 even though the interface's own page (ms909893) is CE 5.0. The CE 5.0 surface is the vtable, which is gated.

name: IPersistFolder
reason: Same as IDropTarget: opaque forward tag required by CE 4.2 shell entry points; the vtable is gated at 5.0.

name: IShellFolder
reason: Named directly by SHGetDesktopFolder (aa453697, CE 4.2 and later) in include/Shlobj.h. Gating the tag would break a documented 4.2 API.

name: IShellView
reason: Referenced by the CE 4.2 shell surface; the published vtable is gated at 5.0.

name: ITaskbarList
reason: Forward tag only; no 4.2 consumer is broken by it and the CE 5.0 page (ms909893) describes the interface, not the opaque name.

name: ITaskbarList2
reason: Forward tag only; same reasoning as ITaskbarList.
